page: Vultr vcg-a16-96c-878g-256vram is a Dedicated Metal GPU server configured with an AMD x86_64 processor. The system features 96 dedicated vCPUs and 877.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 9.14 GB of RAM per core. This high-density memory allocation supports memory-intensive operations alongside multi-threaded processing.

The server is equipped with 16 NVIDIA Ampere A16 GPUs, providing a combined total of 256 GB of VRAM. For local storage, the configuration includes 3072 GB of NVMe SSD storage, facilitating high-speed data access. Additionally, the server includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the bare-metal architecture eliminates virtualization overhead, maximizing the return on hardware resources for dense GPU workloads. The combination of 16 GPUs, massive system memory, and dedicated AMD cores makes this server suitable for high-density virtual desktop infrastructure, video streaming, graphics rendering, and parallelized GPU-accelerated computing tasks.
